descripcion: Ten minutes for anyone who has never played: sit down, pick up your sheet, roll your pool in the tower and learn to read the house dice.

pasos.texto: Sit at the table (any seat but the high one to the north)
Pick up your sheet from the table, in front of the seat by the door
Go to the dice tower and roll 3d6 (the 3d6 button or /tirar 3d6)

textos.aceptada: The table is waiting for you. The mission book (key J) marks every step.
textos.completada: Now you can read the dice: sixes count, ones weigh.

notas: Template of the tabletop room: the apprentice's table. The mission does not check the roll: the whole table sees it. The close is one of Senet's options (avanzar_paso).
